notes.title: Get a Glimpse of 'Carry Onward' with the New Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm thrilled to share that the demo version of Carry Onward is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44050001/2e222c2cc606d85c135fa2e75b88c7b68f91a9e9.jpg

This compact demo offers a sneak peek into Thomas' emotional journey towards finding peace and hope. Step inside his home, ready for you to explore, and get introduced to his heartfelt narrative. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44050001/e32025f16403fdc0af6a50893b81ee5ab09f8e38.jpg

By interacting with items, you will get a sense of Thomas' inner turmoil, standing at life's crossroads. How do these objects make him feel? And how does he grapple with the thought of leaving his beloved home behind? In the full game, your interpretation of Thomas' emotional state will guide you to one of four distinct endings - or even a secret one. Choose wisely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44050001/ed04c79211835d042c3b3c5b91cb2cb98545b5c2.jpg

Your feedback is invaluable to me, so feel free to share your thoughts on Steam forums, Discord, Twitter, or via carrier pigeon!

Enjoy the demo, and don't forget to wishlist the full game - it is launching soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353440/Carry_Onward/

Carry Onward,
Andrey.
